priorPolicyEvidence: Previous resumed receipt verified project-only maximum 30 days after save/reload through creation-form readback; not modified again here.
manualSteps: In the TenBot API Keys list, first check whether TenBotHostedTerraPilot has appeared since the last observation. Do not create a duplicate if it exists.
If absent, click Create new secret key. Set name TenBotHostedTerraPilot and project TenBot.
Select Expiration 30 days and Restricted permissions.
Expand Model capabilities. Set Responses (/v1/responses) to Write. Leave every other capability None.
Privately click Create secret key and handle its one-time value through the approved secure-entry mechanism.
Close the one-time secret display before automated metadata verification resumes.
